description: Learn how to store information and solve problems one small step at a time. A data structure holds things, like books on a shelf. An algorithm is a set of steps, like a recipe. Choose JavaScript, C, C++, Python, C#, or Java and follow the same examples in 28 lessons. Start with lists, then explore searching, sorting, trees, graphs, and dynamic programming. Each lesson explains the idea with small numbers, shows the result, and gives you a change to try. You only need to know variables, loops, and functions in one language. JavaScript runs here; the other languages have local setup steps and a source download.
versionNote: Examples use JavaScript, C11, C++17, Python 3, C# (.NET 8+), and Java 17+. Only JavaScript runs on this website.
whatYouWillLearn: Choose a language and run a small program
Store items in arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, sets, and maps
Find a value with linear search or binary search
Compare bubble, selection, insertion, merge, and quick sort
Explore trees, search trees, heaps, and graphs
Use recursion, two pointers, and dynamic programming
learningObjectives: Trace a program with a tiny example and check its output
Explain how time and extra memory grow as the input grows
Choose a data structure that fits a simple task
Handle empty lists, missing values, and repeated values
Compare the same idea in six programming languages

seo.title: DSA Tutorial: JavaScript, C, C++, Python, C# and Java
seo.description: Learn data structures and algorithms in six languages. Follow 28 simple lessons on lists, sorting, trees, graphs, and more, with examples and practice.
